summary.business_type: SaaS / open-source desktop software (free local-first markdown editor for macOS, Windows, Linux)
top_findings: Font-loading LCP fix recommended in July is still not implemented — Inter font still loads via a render-blocking fonts.googleapis.com -> fonts.gstatic.com chain, LCP flat at ~3s on both pages
/docs JSON-LD url field points at the homepage instead of its own canonical /docs/ URL, and duplicates the homepage SoftwareApplication block instead of a page-appropriate schema type
No open-source license declared on-site or in the GitHub repo despite 'open source' being part of the product's marketing claim -- now the single biggest E-E-A-T/trust gap
/docs and /docs/ still both return 200 with identical content and no redirect between them
No comparison/alternatives content ('inkwell vs Obsidian') -- reconfirmed live absent; high-intent comparison-dominated queries remain structurally unaddressable
quick_wins: Self-host the Inter font + @font-face, drop redundant Google Fonts preconnect tags (~1 hr, should push LCP into 'Good' territory)
Fix the /docs JSON-LD url field to https://inkwell-lp.vercel.app/docs/ (30 min)
Add a 308 redirect /docs -> /docs/ in vercel.json and fix the internal nav link (30 min)
Declare an actual open-source license on the repo and site footer (30 min, no design work)
Harden CSP style-src (still unsafe-inline, unlike the already-hashed script-src) (30-60 min)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt (200, correct Allow/Sitemap directive) and sitemap-index.xml -> sitemap-0.xml (200, 3 URLs) both working
Canonical tags present and correct on all 3 pages, driven by astro.config.mjs `site` now being set
Full security header suite live: CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, HSTS -- verified even on the 404 response
JSON-LD SoftwareApplication schema present (softwareVersion 0.7.8, correct offers/downloadUrl)
og:image (live 1200x630 asset, 200) + full Twitter Card meta present
Version inconsistency fixed -- single source of truth in src/consts.ts (APP_VERSION="0.7.8"), consistent across homepage and docs
CSP script-src correctly hardened with SHA-256 hashes (not unsafe-inline)

findings.title: /docs and /docs/ still both return 200 with identical content, no redirect
findings.description: Canonical tags mitigate but don't eliminate the duplicate-URL condition. Internal nav still links to the non-slash /docs path.
findings.recommendation: Add a 308 redirect in vercel.json plus fix the internal link.

findings.title: CSP style-src still uses unsafe-inline
findings.description: script-src was hardened with hashes in the recent CSP fix, but style-src was not -- a CSS-injection/exfiltration vector remains open.
findings.recommendation: Hash or nonce the inline styles and remove unsafe-inline from style-src.

findings.title: Google Fonts still loaded render-blocking/cross-origin
findings.description: Unresolved from the July audit. See Performance category for the LCP impact.
findings.recommendation: Self-host the Inter font.

findings.title: No custom 404 page
findings.description: Vercel's plaintext default still served; correct status code is returned so no SEO penalty.
findings.recommendation: Add src/pages/404.astro.

findings.title: IndexNow protocol not implemented
findings.description: Now unblocked since sitemap exists.
findings.recommendation: Implement IndexNow for faster re-indexing on updates.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Version mismatch fixed -- homepage and /docs both show v0.7.8, matching JSON-LD softwareVersion
Meta description fixed -- now says 'macOS, Windows, and Linux' (was 'macOS' only)
/docs Getting Started now has separate install steps for macOS, Windows, and Linux
New /privacy page (200 OK, linked in both footers) gives specific, verifiable claims
SoftwareApplication JSON-LD now present sitewide
Homepage (~1,000+ words) and /docs (~2,500 words, 9 sections) both comfortably clear content-depth floors

findings.title: No About, Contact, Terms, License, or Changelog pages
findings.description: All 404. GitHub repo has no declared license despite the 'open source' marketing claim -- the biggest remaining trust gap.
findings.recommendation: Declare a real open-source license (repo + site), add a one-line maintainer/About identity.

findings.title: Authoritativeness remains weak (38/100)
findings.description: Only signal is an anonymous, unlicensed GitHub org, 67 stars, no press/testimonials/named maintainer.
findings.recommendation: Surface star count, add maintainer identity, pursue a small amount of earned coverage.

findings.title: /privacy reuses the SoftwareApplication schema verbatim
findings.description: Semantically odd -- a privacy page isn't the software entity.
findings.recommendation: Give /privacy its own WebPage schema type.

findings.title: Docs Abbreviations section has a stale static example date
findings.description: Example date is stale relative to today despite a recent docs update commit.
findings.recommendation: Refresh or make the example date-relative in prose.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Title tag and meta description now name all three platforms (the July High finding is resolved)
Clean single-H1 hierarchy carried over from July

findings.title: Not independently re-audited this cycle
findings.description: Whether Claude MCP is still buried as an equal-weight homepage tile, and whether mobile nav still hides Features/Canvas/Themes/GitHub/Docs, were not re-verified. Score is a cross-referenced estimate, not a fresh measurement.
findings.recommendation: Run a dedicated on-page + visual/mobile re-audit next cycle.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: SoftwareApplication JSON-LD now live on both pages (was zero in July)
Syntactically valid: correct schema.org context, no deprecated types, no placeholder text
No fabricated aggregateRating/review data -- correctly omitted

findings.title: /docs JSON-LD url field points at the homepage instead of /docs/
findings.description: A copy-paste error: the url field is https://inkwell-lp.vercel.app/ instead of the page's own canonical URL.
findings.recommendation: Fix the url field to https://inkwell-lp.vercel.app/docs/.

findings.title: /docs duplicates the exact homepage SoftwareApplication block
findings.description: Same name/version/offers, only the description differs, instead of a page-appropriate type. Creates entity ambiguity for crawlers/AI. Same issue on /privacy.
findings.recommendation: Replace with a WebPage node using about/isPartOf references back to the homepage's SoftwareApplication entity.

findings.title: Missing sitewide Organization and WebSite schema
findings.description: No publisher/site-level entity anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization + WebSite JSON-LD to the homepage (ready-to-paste code using only verified live values in findings/schema.md).

categories.name: Performance
what_works: CLS is a perfect 0.000 on both pages
TBT is 0ms on both pages
No regressions from the CSP/accessibility work

findings.title: LCP still 'Needs Improvement', font-loading fix still not implemented
findings.description: Homepage LCP 3.09s (85/100), Docs LCP 2.96s (87/100) -- essentially flat vs. July (2.83s/3.1s). preconnect hints were added as a side effect of the CSP work but the actual cross-origin Google Fonts stylesheet request remains, still costing ~1,950-2,080ms of render-blocking time per Lighthouse.
findings.recommendation: Self-host the Inter woff2 files with @font-face + preload for the critical weight; drop the now-redundant Google Fonts preconnect tags.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: /llms.txt now live (200), well-formed with summary, feature list, page links, GitHub source link
robots.txt still Allow: / for all UAs, unblocking GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/OAI-SearchBot
Both pages server-rendered, fully readable without JS execution
SoftwareApplication JSON-LD present on both pages

findings.title: /docs has 47 headings but only 1 carries a real id attribute
findings.description: No deep-linkable citation targets for AI systems -- unresolved from July.
findings.recommendation: Add id attributes to every H2/H3 on /docs.

findings.title: Wikipedia naming collision unresolved
findings.description: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inkwell_(software) still covers Apple's unrelated discontinued macOS feature, no on-site disambiguation.
findings.recommendation: Consistently render the brand as 'inkwell by [org]' in titles/first-sentence copy.

findings.title: No Organization/Person/FAQPage schema, no author/date bylines, no RSL licensing file
findings.description: Limits authority signals available to AI answer engines.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQPage schema where natural, add a licensing file, add bylines where applicable.

categories.name: Images
what_works: og:image (1200x630) now live -- the July High finding is resolved
No heavy image assets, no broken images (carried from July, not independently re-verified)

findings.title: Not independently re-audited this cycle
findings.description: Underlying image practices (alt text, width/height) were not re-verified; score is adjusted from the confirmed og:image fix, not a fresh pass.
findings.recommendation: Run a dedicated images re-audit next cycle.

categories.name: Search Experience (SXO) -- supplementary
what_works: Re-confirmed live: homepage remains a well-formed Landing Page for product-aware visitors

findings.title: No Comparison Page or persona/use-case content -- reconfirmed live absent
findings.description: /alternatives, /vs, /compare all still 404. Comparison-dominated queries like 'obsidian alternative' remain structurally unaddressable.
findings.recommendation: Build a dedicated comparison page/section with a feature matrix.

findings.title: Score not fully re-verified this cycle
findings.description: The SXO pass hit its turn limit before a fresh SERP pull and persona re-scoring could complete. Score is carried over from July.
findings.recommendation: Run a full, uninterrupted SXO re-pass next cycle.

findings.title: No custom domain -- unchanged since July
findings.description: Site still runs on the shared vercel.app subdomain, reconfirmed by the Technical audit's canonical URL check.
findings.recommendation: Register a custom domain and 301-redirect from inkwell-lp.vercel.app.
